emails.subject: Reducing alert fatigue at MediTrust Health
emails.body:
Hi Priya,

I noticed MediTrust Health is investing in healthcare security and that alert fatigue is on your radar.

Our platform helps teams like yours cut alert noise with risk-ranked detections and automated triage. It connects to the tools you already use and produces an auditable trail.

Teams of a similar size have reduced manual review time by about 40% within the first quarter.

Would a 20-minute technical walkthrough next week be useful?

Best regards,
Growvion Security Team
